reason: The README describes a DSH Web UI plugin that calculates estimated session costs from token usage and displays them alongside usage statistics, with optional manual price refreshing.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中根据 token 用量和可配置价格表估算会话费用，并支持手动刷新价格。
summaries.en: Estimates session costs in the DSH Web UI from token usage and configurable price tables, with optional manual price refreshing.

capabilities: Calculates estimated session costs from token usage
Displays cost and token-bucket statistics in the DSH Web UI
Stores configurable price data in browser localStorage
Fetches pricing data from a configured URL when manually triggered
Writes diagnostic page content to a local debug directory when parsing fails
